IS 16089 : 2013 : Jute Agro-Textile - Sapling Bags for Growth of Seedling/SaplingICS 55.080; 59.080.70; 65.020.20TXD 35Reaffirmed 20221 SCOPEThis standard specifies requirements of jute sapling bag made from hessian cloth to use for growth of sapling in nursery.NOTE - Selection of size and quality of sapling bag shall be decided principally on topography of the site, annual rainfall, nature of soil, type of sapling/seedling etc.2 REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
